summary: SOLAI Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 18, 2026, announcing a plan to change its American Depositary Share (ADS) ratio from one ADS representing 100 Class A ordinary shares to one ADS representing 700 such shares, effective on or about July 6, 2026. This ADS ratio change effectively functions as a one-for-seven reverse share split for ADS holders, with no impact on the underlying ordinary shares or issuance of fractional new ADSs. The trading symbol remains SLAI on the NYSE. The company expects a proportional increase in ADS trading price but provides no assurance. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation.
